newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were narrowly mixed in the after-hours session on Tuesday after prices posted modest gains on short-covering during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.2 yen per kg lower to 0.3 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark March was 0.1 yen up at 132.7 yen. Activity was sluggish with 5,714 lots traded.
During the day, short-covering, particularly in nearby months, lifted the market but gains in distant months were limited by selling pressure from trade houses.
Traders said any upside potential would be limited as Japan's rubber stocks have not reached their ceiling yet.
